decisions.rationale: Repeat G1 core vs their likely Sneasler/Chomp/Chandy/Arcanine. MegaGengar+Prankster screens control and blunt physicals; Defiant Ape + LO LiquidVoice Prima are primary wincons. Glis/Avalugg reserved for Dragonite/Houndstone sighting.

Lead Sneasler+Chandelure vs Gengar screens. Sneasler Fake Out stops Disable, Chandelure Infiltrator Shadow Ball ignores screens and hits Gengar/Annihilape super. Dragonite Tailwind lets 145 Chandelure and 88 Houndstone outspeed 165-200 Mega Gengar, EQ hits Gengar SE. Houndstone gives second Ghost to escape Shadow Tag and Last Respects wincon. Avoid Arcanine Intimidate into Defiant and avoid Scarf Garchomp getting Disabled.
decisions.notebook: Opp Mega Gengar Timid Shadow Tag SB/Sludge/Disable/Protect traps choiced mons. Grimmsnarl Light Clay Prankster FakeOut/Reflect/LightScreen/SpiritBreak screens. Annihilape Leftovers Defiant RageFist/CC/DrainPunch/Protect procs on Intimidate. Primarina LO LiquidVoice HyperVoice/Moonblast/IceBeam/Protect spread Water. Gliscor Occa HyperCutter EQ/IceFang/Knock/Protect. Avalugg Sitrus Sturdy BodyPress/Recover/WideGuard/IcicleCrash blocks spread. Our plan: no Intimidate into Annihilape unless burned, use Ghosts to escape Tag, Infiltrator vs screens, Tailwind to outspeed Mega Gengar, avoid Choice lock vs Disable.

decisions.rationale: Mega+SB Chandy threatens KO/Infiltrator chip; Prankster Reflect blunts Sneasler FO/CC/Gunk and Chandy physicals while Mega Shadow Tag locks both. Screens first turn maximizes Light Clay value vs their offense lead.

Chandelure Shadow Ball is guaranteed OHKO vs Gengar (100-238%) and Infiltrator bypasses screens. Grimmsnarl threatens Fake Out on Sneasler to stop Gunk Shot; Sneasler 189 Speed > Grimmsnarl 80-112 so Fake Out Grimmsnarl goes first and flinches it, securing the Gengar KO and denying Reflect/Light Screen.

Mega Gengar Shadow Tag traps non-Ghosts. Dragonite would be trapped and Disabled. Houndstone is Ghost immune to Tag, threatens Gengar with Last Respects (100 BP now) + Shadow Sneak priority, while Sneasler can Gunk Shot Grimmsnarl for likely KO. Preserves Tailwind option later.

Plan G2: same core vs repeat; swap Grimm for Glis/Avalugg on Dragonite/Houndstone sighting. RF count persists on Ape. Houndstone LastRespects scales (Chandy faint).

Houndstone Last Respects would KO Gengar (100BP with 1 faint ~81-189%) but Gengar outspeeds and Shadow Ball is 53-168% vs Houndstone, so Protect preserves our only Ghost attacker that can hit Gengar and escape Shadow Tag.

decisions.rationale: SB KO range on Fluffy Houndstone under Reflect; Spirit Break drops Atk and chips. Shadow Tag locks both. Avoid Protect fail and Sneasler Gunk on Grimm. Screens already up.

Mega Gengar Shadow Ball guaranteed OHKO vs Houndstone (134-224%). Houndstone is Ghost so can escape Shadow Tag by switching to Dragonite, whose Multiscale tanks Shadow Ball (24-72% -> halved). Sneasler is trapped and threatened by Grimmsnarl Fake Out + Gengar Disable; Protect blocks both and wastes their turn while Reflect is up.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite at 2% only acts with +2 Extreme Speed before Mega Gengar Shadow Ball. It cannot hit Gengar (Normal immune) so must chip Grimmsnarl. Sneasler Gunk Shot is 2x vs Grimmsnarl and best chance to KO through Reflect when combined with ESpeed. Protect on Sneasler is reduced after last turn and would waste KO window.
KO 2% Dragonite with Gengar Shadow Ball (immune to ES/CC); Ape Rage Fist Dragonite for free KO if needed or chip. Reflect up; Sneasler Gunk disabled. Shadow Tag traps. Primarina later.

Sneasler Gunk Shot disabled by Disable, Close Combat immune to both foes so must waste into Gengar to avoid KOing ally with EQ. Dragonite at 2% dies before Tailwind vs faster Mega Gengar, EQ OHKOs own Sneasler, Claw/ES blocked by Reflect/immunity. Switching to Houndstone preserves Dragonite and brings Fluffy Ghost to check Annihilape.

Dragonite at 2% dies anyway and can't damage Ghosts with ESpeed. Use priority ESpeed into Sneasler to proc Sitrus+Unburden (77-91% -> 34-48% after Sitrus) before Gengar moves, then Sneasler CC ally KOs Dragonite to guarantee Houndstone (Ghost escapes Shadow Tag) entry this turn even if foe ignores Dragonite. Sneasler otherwise has only immune CC or disabled Gunk Shot.

reflections.summary: Won via strong preview (Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl screens + Ape) that immediately deleted Infiltrator Chandelure, set Reflect, Disabled Sneasler, and cleaned Dragonite/Houndstone with minimal damage taken.
reflections.adjustment: Preview was correct vs this bring; next game keep Mega Gengar lead pressure but respect Houndstone LastRespects scaling by ensuring Ape/Primarina enter after fewer free faints or with Reflect already up.

reflections.summary: Lost in preview. Brought Chandelure + Houndstone + Sneasler + Dragonite into Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl - three Ghost-weak targets that all die to Timid Mega Shadow Ball. Chandelure OHKO T1 before doing anything, Dragonite lost Multiscale to Shadow Ball + super-effective Spirit Break and never got Tailwind, Houndstone (Fluffy) has no value vs special Gengar behind Reflect. Game ended after decision error T5 Dragonite Extreme Speed into ally Sneasler, which then Close Combat KO'd Dragonite and Geng
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Chandelure vs this Gengar/Grimmsnarl lead. Next game lead Houndstone (Ghost immune to Shadow Tag) + Sneasler to deny Fake Out and block trap, or Houndstone + Dragonite to Protect + Tailwind T1 to preserve Multiscale. Save Will-O-Wisp for Annihilape entry and only use Last Respects after 2+ allies fainted; avoid double Ghost vs Gengar.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Mega Gengar Timid ShadowTag SB/Sludge/Disable/Protect - leads with Grimmsnarl, focuses Ghosts T1, Protects T2 expecting double, uses Disable T4 to shut Sneasler, sets Reflect early. Grimmsnarl LightClay Prankster FakeOut/Reflect/LightScreen/SpiritBreak - Spirit Break super-effective vs Dragonite and drops SpA. Annihilape Leftovers Defiant RageFist/CC/DrainPunch/Protect kept in back to clean vs weakened team. Primarina LO LiquidVoice HyperVoice/Moonblast/IceBeam/Protect, Gliscor Occa HyperCutter EQ/IceFang/Knock/Protect, Avalugg Sitrus Sturdy BodyPress/Recover/WideGuard/IcicleCrash unseen. Our tech: Chandelure LO Timid dies to Mega Gengar SB, Dragonite Lum Adamant Multiscale broken by SB, Sneasler Jolly Sitrus Unburden procs at ~50% to 72% but disabled, Houndstone Fluffy Leftovers WillOWisp/LastRespects/ShadowSneak/Protect needs WoW vs Annihilape. Plan next: Lead Ghost-immune Houndstone + Fake Out Sneasler or Tailwind Dragonite, deny Reflect value, preserve Multiscale, scale Last Respects.
